name: fix-a-bug
description: Use when something is broken, a test fails, or behavior is not what was expected. Reproduce first, trace to root cause with one hypothesis at a time, then fix small with a regression test.

repro_command.description: Minimal command that reproduces the failure.

repro_output.description: Full failure output (message, stack, exit code).

hypothesis.description: One sentence: 'X is root cause because Y'.

attempt.description: Hypothesis attempt number. >=3 without fix escalates.

proposed_fix.description: Smallest change at source. Only after a confirmed hypothesis.
